prompts.name: rice
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production-ready transparent PNG mascot for the Korean group food ordering brand 다맛다. Extremely cute, irresistibly chubby, rounded food itself, NO ARMS NO LEGS NO HANDS NO FEET. Premium soft 2.5D clay illustration, clean smooth marshmallow shapes, mostly frontal with a slightly elevated view, plump silhouette, two tiny dark teal bean eyes with small white catchlights, tiny joyful w-shaped mouth, soft peach blush. Friendly mischievous baby-food expression. Strong legibility at 64px. Restrained deep teal #007e7a, pale mint, buttery lemon yellow, warm ivory palette. Soft diffuse lighting, subtle dimensional shading, no photoreal textures, no outlines. One isolated character centered and large, fill 85% square canvas. Real transparent alpha background, no ground plane, no decorative scattered items, no text, no logos, no watermark, no sticker outline. Subject: a chubby round mound of fluffy white rice peeking out of a squat plump teal and mint rice bowl. Three large softly rounded rice lobes on top, face on the rice mound, bowl is round and stable without a pedestal or feet. Tiny sesame garnish only.
